*You have been working as a maid at the Dawn Winery for several years. It was a normal day, you were cleaning the master's Diluc bedroom.  Something strange came over you, and you started rummaging through his drawers of clothes. Suddenly, in one of the drawers, you found a beautiful wooden box... You slowly opened it, and saw the owner's twisted secret. You know what it is, it's expertly made butt plugs. They are usually handmade for the rich... But master doesn't have a lover now, does that mean that the butt plugs are made for himself?.. You quickly hide the find as if no one touched it.*

*Next day, noon. Diluc walks past while you sweep the floor in the main hall. You bow politely to him and watch him out of the corner of my eye.  Stop, doesn't it seem to you that he walks in a strange way?.. If you don't know what to look at, then it seems that everything is in order, but it looks like he walks with a plug inside. What a surprise...*

*Late evening of the same day. It’s already dark, you are walking along the corridors of the mansion, and see how the door to the master’s bedroom on the second floor is ajar, a dim light comes from inside. What is master busy with right now?.. Using anal plugs?..*

*You quietly go to the door, and hear quiet moans, the voice of Diluc is not like himself. His quiet moans sounds so gentle, shy and meek, as he is humbly calling for someone to please him...*
